phases.title: Baseline, design contract and delivery foundations
phases.outcome: A reproducible v3 reference, honest starting inventory, migration strategy and working progress system.
phases.rationale: Prevents rebuilding existing features, losing owner records, or treating a new screen as a complete feature.
phases.design: Inventory all four tabs, center add, onboarding, sheets and roadside mode. Preserve native brand-logo selection as the user-approved exception.
phases.data: Record current Room schema, persisted defaults, originals/crops/previews, money conversions and the primary vehicle ID. Specify stable bike IDs for new contracts without prematurely migrating every table.
exit_criteria: Tracker validates and generated documents match its data.
Synthetic old-vault fixtures and native screenshot/motion baselines exist for Android and iOS.
The data evolution decision records schema ownership, money precision, bike scoping, asset ownership and rollback.
phases.risks: The v3 directory is currently untracked. Preserve its bytes; include its reviewed sources when a future commit is authorized. Historical docs are evidence, not current runtime proof.

acceptance: Record existing capabilities, demo concepts, observed gaps, source anchors and verification limits.
verification: Cross-check the production entrypoint, storage, reminder wiring, factory profiles and prototype source.

verification: Reference real prototype files and preserve source hashes for detecting later reference changes.

Define sanitized fixture format, import limits, durable Undo and the local backup version policy.

phases.title: Trustworthy reminders and understandable maintenance status
phases.outcome: Every reminder switch controls real behavior; maintenance cards communicate recorded interval status accurately.
phases.rationale: These are promises already visible in v3 and should be completed before widening the app.
phases.design: Home NextUp, gauge details, Vault expiry chips and Me reminder rows. Reuse Sheet, Switch, date chips, status icon/text and one-tap service entry.
phases.data: Migrate platform renewal opt-in and new global/per-document settings into one explicit policy. Preserve consumed identities and scheduled events; do not infer notification permission from a saved switch.
exit_criteria: Service and document notifications open the correct record and honor all opt-outs.
UI lead times match native scheduling and permission state.
Stale mileage, unknown baselines and interval-based percentages are visible; no physical part-health claim.
Real Android and iPhone background delivery, denial, restart and settings tests are recorded.
phases.risks: OS delivery can be delayed. Never claim an exact alarm guarantee; mileage reminders cannot know unrecorded travel.

tasks.title: Unify reminder policy, settings and migration
acceptance: Choose and document default warning lead times, local reminder time, snooze and per-record/global overrides.
Reconcile the present 30-day UI versus 60-day native policy and migrate existing opt-in without enabling denied notifications.
verification: Test old settings import, expiry edits, clock/timezone changes, late additions, deduplication and save failure.

notes.text: P00-D02: current Room mapping drops v3 settings. P00-D05: no-expiry registration shows zero days remaining. Use the new data contract and preserve real notification consent.

evidence.summary: P00-D02: current Room mapping drops v3 settings. P00-D05: no-expiry registration shows zero days remaining. Use the new data contract and preserve real notification consent.

tasks.title: Connect service and document scheduling after durable saves
acceptance: Schedule from the committed snapshot; cancel obsolete events after edits, deletion and opt-out.
Add stable service task identities and actionable deep links; preserve consumed-event recovery and background reconciliation.
verification: Test stale snapshots, rollback/Undo, restart, identity collisions and notification taps for a missing or changed record.

notes.text: P00-D01: Android and iOS keep odometer 12350 after Undo intended for 12340. The callback closes over an old revision. Fix inverse command handling without bypassing concurrency checks.

evidence.summary: P00-D01: Android and iOS keep odometer 12350 after Undo intended for 12340. The callback closes over an old revision. Fix inverse command handling without bypassing concurrency checks.

tasks.title: Implement reminder settings, permission recovery and snooze in v3
acceptance: Show actual enabled/denied state and matching schedule in Me and Vault.
Open the exact service/document from a notification; snooze without pretending a task was completed.
verification: Exercise deny, revoke, return-from-settings, save failure and screen-reader labels on both native hosts.

notes.text: P00 baseline confirms no-expiry presentation and native reminder settings need a consistent visible policy. Include these captured states in acceptance.

evidence.summary: P00 baseline confirms no-expiry presentation and native reminder settings need a consistent visible policy. Include these captured states in acceptance.

tasks.title: Make gauges, unknown history and stale mileage honest
acceptance: Call percentages interval remaining; show basis, last confirmed mileage/date and schedule source in details.
Unknown service history cannot show reassuring measured health; estimates need explicit confirmation before saving.
verification: Test whichever-limit-first, overdue text, no-data, future/invalid baseline rejection and reduced-motion rendering.

tasks.title: Verify reminders and status on real devices
acceptance: Complete Android and iPhone delivery, foreground/background, denied permission, restart and deep-link scenarios with synthetic records.
Recheck v3 Home/Vault/Me in light/dark, large text, both digit styles and reduced motion.
verification: Retain native reports and recordings; distinguish a short-delay probe from an actual expiry policy test.

phases.title: Document privacy and safe phone handover
phases.outcome: Owners control access to sensitive documents and can safely show one selected document.
phases.rationale: The vault holds identity and ownership data; privacy belongs before backup and wider sharing.
phases.design: Me gains a Privacy section; Vault uses masked summaries and a protected document sheet. Extend existing roadside mode with a clear scope and exit action.
phases.data: Version privacy preferences. Separate device-bound keys from portable backup secrets. Encrypt sensitive local assets only through a resumable, validated migration; document any plaintext database metadata remaining.
exit_criteria: Device-credential/biometric access, timeout and recovery behavior work on both platforms.
Selected-document mode cannot expose other records through back, deep links, recents or resume.
Local encryption claims match the implemented key/data coverage and failure recovery.
phases.risks: An app lock is not database encryption. Encryption design must preserve originals and handle lost or invalidated keys without silently wiping records.

tasks.title: Review privacy threat model, key lifecycle and recovery
acceptance: Specify what is locked/encrypted, what remains metadata, how keys survive upgrades and how lost keys are handled.
Select reviewed platform cryptography and key storage; document backup interoperability without custom crypto.
verification: Review shared-phone, stolen-file, app-switcher, export-cache and key-invalidation cases.

tasks.title: Implement secure key and sensitive-asset storage adapters
acceptance: Use authenticated encryption with versioned asset metadata and platform-protected local keys.
Migrate assets with staging, verification and recovery; preserve originals until the durable new reference is committed.
verification: Test interrupted migration, altered ciphertext, missing/invalid keys, disk-full and no plaintext temporary export leaks.

tasks.title: Add lock, auto-lock, masking and selected-document inspection
acceptance: Use system credentials/biometrics with an accessible fallback and clear recovery message.
Lock on timeout/background; reveal only chosen documents and minimize sensitive notification/app-switcher content.
verification: Test cancellation, biometric lockout, no enrolled biometric, deep links, rotation, background/resume and back navigation.

tasks.title: Protect export, import and temporary-file boundaries
acceptance: Require deliberate access for sensitive exports; clean temporary decrypted files after share/cancel.
Avoid sensitive values in logs, error reports and screenshots used as project evidence.
verification: Inspect temporary directories, native shares and malformed import failures using synthetic sensitive fixtures.

tasks.title: Verify privacy and key recovery on physical Android and iPhone
acceptance: Exercise key storage, credential changes, lockout, background screenshots and selected-document handover.
Record the exact local-at-rest coverage and recovery limitations in user-facing help and engineering evidence.
verification: Run on both real devices; use v3 theme/large-text/reduced-motion checks for protected flows.

phases.title: Encrypted local backup and complete restore
phases.outcome: A lost phone or reinstall does not erase the ownership record when the owner has a backup.
phases.rationale: Recovery gives long-term value to every record users enter. Cloud transport can follow a proven restore format.
phases.design: Me > Backup uses v3 cards, Sheet steps and date labels. Show last backup, what is included and a restore preview; use real progress only for long file work.
phases.data: Define a portable, versioned authenticated archive containing records, original assets, crops, settings and a manifest. Never export device keys. Regenerable previews may be omitted only if restore recreates them. Restore stages and validates before one durable replacement.
exit_criteria: Cross-platform Android-to-iOS and iOS-to-Android restore preserves records and byte-identical originals.
Wrong secrets, damaged archives, missing assets, unsupported versions, cancellation and low disk space leave the existing vault unchanged.
A full new-install restore drill works on physical devices; backup and notification settings do not silently grant permissions.
phases.risks: Backup-file loss and secret loss are separate failures. Choose a recoverability model explicitly; do not promise recovery without a recovery method.

tasks.title: Specify portable archive, secret handling and compatibility policy
acceptance: Version the manifest, authenticated metadata, asset inventory, size limits and secret derivation.
Specify replace/restore confirmation and recovery method; local lock keys remain device-bound.
verification: Review format against old vaults, future bike-scoped data and the privacy key design.

tasks.title: Implement consistent snapshot export and native file save
acceptance: Freeze a committed revision and include every referenced non-regenerable asset.
Encrypt before handing the file to the native save/share destination; cancellation does not update last-successful-backup.
verification: Test concurrent record changes, missing originals, cancelled save, out-of-space and no leaked plaintext.

tasks.title: Implement staged validation and transactional restore
acceptance: Bound archive expansion and reject unsafe paths, unsupported versions and tampered manifests/assets.
Preview counts and conflicts; atomically restore or roll back without deleting the previous vault; reconcile reminders after success.
verification: Inject interruption at each restore stage and compare records plus asset hashes; test older supported archives and duplicate IDs.

tasks.title: Build backup, restore review and recovery help in v3
acceptance: Explain file destination, backup age, included data and secret recovery in plain Bangla.
Give separate success/error/cancel states; destructive replacement has a concrete review step.
verification: Check accessibility, focus, large text, dark theme and interruption/resume without a false success toast.

tasks.title: Run cross-platform recovery and trustworthy-local-beta gate
acceptance: Restore a synthetic fully populated vault on fresh physical Android and iPhone installations.
Retain cross-platform manifests, original hashes and failure-path results; release only the verified backup behavior.
verification: Exercise wrong secret, missing key, offline restore, partial archive, reinstall and permission re-request.

phases.title: Bangladesh maintenance and used-bike onboarding
phases.outcome: A locally relevant bike setup leads to accurate, explainable owner-confirmed maintenance tasks.
phases.rationale: Daily commuters and used-bike owners need the right schedule and an honest starting baseline.
phases.design: Extend the three-input onboarding with progressive detail only when needed. Keep native brand logos; put schedule provenance and edit actions inside gauge/service sheets.
phases.data: Add action type, source/manual revision, applicability and baseline certainty with compatible defaults. A catalogue entry does not automatically become a manual-backed schedule.
exit_criteria: Initial Bangladesh profile set has checked model/year/market manuals and source pages.
Inspect/clean/lubricate/adjust/replace are separate actions with appropriate reset behavior.
Unknown prior history, running-in and custom owner schedules remain useful without invented certainty.
phases.risks: Do not copy a European or Indian interval into a Bangladesh model by name alone. Local-condition adjustments require a cited manual/dealer basis or an explicit owner setting.

tasks.title: Select initial local models and verify source manuals
acceptance: Choose a small initial set through pilot-owner evidence, not an unsupported popularity ranking.
Record source URL, manual/version/page, market/model code and applicability; retain unsupported-model fallback.
verification: Have every proposed interval and fluid/part recommendation traced to its applicable source.

tasks.title: Model distinct maintenance actions and source-backed schedules
acceptance: Separate inspection, cleaning, lubrication, adjustment and replacement.
Service resets affect selected actions only; preserve custom rules and historical logs during migration.
verification: Test running-in, whichever-limit-first, unsupported model, rule edits and mixed-action service visits.

tasks.title: Add unknown-history and used-bike starting states
acceptance: Let owners choose known last service or unknown baseline without faking a service record.
Suggest an initial inspection checklist; keep unknown state until the owner records a real action.
verification: Check fresh and migrated users, odometer bounds, skipped setup and returning to complete a baseline.

notes.text: P00-D03: unknown-service and empty fixtures currently have the same no-rule shape. Add explicit baseline certainty rather than inventing a service record.

evidence.summary: P00-D03: unknown-service and empty fixtures currently have the same no-rule shape. Add explicit baseline certainty rather than inventing a service record.

tasks.title: Expose schedule source, edits and local care actions in v3
acceptance: Show source/manual or owner-defined label, next due basis and editable intervals in the details sheet.
Keep the fast service flow and support recording several actual actions in one visit.
verification: Compare against v3 service chips, Home urgency order, large text and both digit styles.

tasks.title: Verify schedule migration and Bangladesh setup end to end
acceptance: Old records/rules remain readable and backups round-trip new source/action fields.
Run supported, unsupported and unknown-history scenarios on Android and iOS.
verification: Validate fixture outcomes against the cited manuals and retain native screenshots.

phases.title: BRTA renewal and document assistance
phases.outcome: An expiry warning leads to a useful, sourced renewal checklist and a recorded renewal.
phases.rationale: Document storage is already present; guided action closes the practical ownership loop.
phases.design: Vault document detail gains Renew, official verification and renewal history. Reuse DocAdd review, date chips, receipt attachment and a return-to-document flow.
phases.data: Keep person-level licence documents separate from bike ownership scope. Append renewal events and receipts; preserve prior originals and expiry history instead of overwriting the only copy.
exit_criteria: Checklists are sourced, dated and applicable to the selected document/vehicle.
Official verification opens deliberately; no file or identity number is silently uploaded.
Renewal updates the record, expense and reminder consistently, with rollback on failure.
phases.risks: Official pages and fee rules change. Show last-checked dates and an offline checklist; do not invent a BRTA API, hard-code fees, imply every bike needs every document, or present stored copies as official validation.

tasks.title: Verify official links, document applicability and checklist content
acceptance: Record official sources, checked dates and applicable document categories.
Use a safe fallback when a service URL is unavailable; keep fee estimates separate from confirmed payments.
verification: Open the official QR-verification page and selected renewal/transfer sources; review plain Bangla wording.

tasks.title: Implement renewal events, fee links and original preservation
acceptance: Save previous/new expiry, payment receipt, actual fee and document revision as one reviewed event.
A failed save or Undo cannot leave a fee, file or reminder inconsistent with the document.
verification: Test old document import, missing date, duplicate renewal, cancellation, asset recovery and backup round-trip.

tasks.title: Build renewal checklist and deliberate official-verification actions
acceptance: Show checklist progress, source date and return to the exact document.
Use the native browser/share boundary deliberately; require owner action before uploading a certificate.
verification: Exercise offline/unavailable links, dark/large-text layouts, privacy lock and screen-reader navigation.

notes.text: P00-D04 and D06: compare the native Vault wallet previews and default English type labels with v3 compact Bangla rows. Preserve owner-written free text.

evidence.summary: P00-D04 and D06: compare the native Vault wallet previews and default English type labels with v3 compact Bangla rows. Preserve owner-written free text.

tasks.title: Verify a full renewal on Android and iOS
acceptance: Run from reminder to checklist, payment attachment, renewed document, expense and new reminder.
Use synthetic documents and retain source freshness plus native evidence.
verification: Test deny/cancel/failure and ensure original bytes remain intact.

phases.title: Ownership costs, budgets and fuel confidence
phases.outcome: History explains recorded ownership costs and helps plan upcoming spending.
phases.rationale: Extends the existing 30-day total into practical decisions for cost-conscious owners.
phases.design: History retains its summary and expandable timeline. Add period/category chips and a cost-details sheet; keep fuel entry taka-first and use the v3 keypad.
phases.data: Add parking/toll/other expenses and budget targets as bike-scoped-compatible records. Convert legacy money explicitly to poisha; document rounding, record coverage and date boundaries.
exit_criteria: Fuel, service, renewal and other expenses reconcile without duplication.
Cost/km uses a defensible recorded-distance window and says insufficient data when needed.
Fuel prices have owner-confirmed value/date/source; prototype placeholders never masquerade as current official prices.
phases.risks: Missing records and partial fills can make averages misleading. Maintenance allowance is a user budget estimate, not a financial forecast.

tasks.title: Define money, distance coverage and cost metrics
acceptance: Specify integer-poisha conversions, category rules, date windows and recorded-distance denominator.
Define full-to-full fuel confidence and missing-data states before drawing a chart.
verification: Review examples containing partial fills, backdated records, no mileage and renewal fees.

tasks.title: Implement expenses, budgets and pure cost calculations
acceptance: Support fuel/service/renewal/parking/toll/custom expenses and owner-entered budgets.
Preserve existing logs; prevent renewal double counting and isolate calculations from UI.
verification: Test rounding, refunds/corrections policy, month boundaries, duplicate IDs and incomplete distance history.

tasks.title: Add fuel price provenance and incomplete-cycle explanations
acceptance: Ask for confirmation of a first price; retain effective date and manually editable remembered values.
Explain insufficient mileage data and avoid silently treating every fill as a completed cycle.
verification: Test price changes, decimal/digit inputs, partial fills, missed fills and editing an old fill.

tasks.title: Build cost details, category entry and budgets in v3
acceptance: Extend existing History cards and timeline with accessible period/category controls.
Use common keypad/date chips, clear coverage labels and optional maintenance allowance.
verification: Reconcile visible totals to fixture records; check both digit styles, themes and large text.

tasks.title: Verify cost migration, edit/Undo and export consistency
acceptance: Migrated money and every edited/deleted expense reconcile across History and backup.
Run cost workflows on both hosts without implying estimates are complete lifetime costs.
verification: Retain native evidence and independent fixture totals for complete and incomplete histories.

phases.title: Native quick capture: odometer, share and Bangla voice
phases.outcome: Useful records can be drafted quickly from a photo, shared text or Bangla speech.
phases.rationale: Reduces the effort needed to maintain a useful ownership history.
phases.design: Keep the center add menu and existing fuel/service/odometer sheets. Native capture fills the existing review draft, keeping explicit confirmation and durable Undo.
phases.data: Persist only confirmed records. Draft source/confidence is bounded metadata; images/audio retention is explicit. Share targets must select the intended bike and cannot bypass a locked vault.
exit_criteria: Camera, share target and voice each have a real implementation or a clearly unavailable state on each platform.
All extracted text, amounts and odometers are reviewed; low confidence never silently writes data.
Native permissions and offline capability are honestly reflected in the UI.
phases.risks: Bangla speech accuracy varies by device/provider and may require network. Decide data processing and retention before selecting a provider; an unavailable provider must not block manual entry.

tasks.title: Define reviewed drafts and unify numeric/text parsing
acceptance: Use one normalized draft for manual, pasted, photo and voice inputs with explicit source/confidence.
Accept supported digit sets; distinguish expense from odometer numbers and detect duplicate shared messages.
verification: Test real-language synthetic messages, ambiguous totals, malformed amounts and invalid odometer regressions.

tasks.title: Implement odometer camera OCR with review and fallback
acceptance: Recognize odometer candidates and show image/candidate review before applying to the sheet.
Camera denial, blur, glare and no result preserve a usable manual flow.
verification: Run a synthetic printed-display corpus and physical-camera checks; reject implausible readings.

tasks.title: Implement Android and iOS share-to-draft entry
acceptance: Accept explicitly shared text through native targets, validate payload limits and route to a locked/reviewable draft.
Do not read the SMS inbox or clipboard automatically.
verification: Test cold/warm start, locked app, duplicate share, unsupported payload and share cancellation on both devices.

tasks.title: Implement Bangla voice drafting with clear processing choice
acceptance: Show start/stop/cancel and processing/offline availability; obtain native mic permission only when used.
Review transcript and parsed fields; do not retain raw audio by default.
verification: Check bn-BD examples, noisy input, provider/network failure, permission denial and stopping after backgrounding.

tasks.title: Validate quick-capture effort and v3 interaction parity
acceptance: Measure task success, corrections and steps against existing manual entry with representative pilot owners.
All capture flows preserve fixed Save placement, native back behavior, focus, reduced motion and confirmed Undo.
verification: Record results for photo/share/voice/manual paths on both platforms; retain limitations rather than a blanket accuracy claim.

phases.title: Core ownership release gate
phases.outcome: A reviewable, recoverable and verified core app can be piloted and released independently of later additions.
phases.rationale: Release confidence is a separate deliverable from completing feature code.
phases.design: Audit the complete four-tab experience. Remove obsolete demo claims from enabled production flows while preserving v3 layout, motion and native brand logos.
phases.data: Freeze a supported schema and backup version; validate upgrade from the committed baseline and retain rollback/recovery instructions.
exit_criteria: Core feature acceptance and migration/restore gates pass.
Real Android and iPhone lifecycle, offline, privacy, accessibility and performance evidence exists.
A pilot report resolves critical failures; release packaging, signing, privacy declarations and store review are separately approved/executed.
phases.risks: Do not delay the core release for P2/P3 scope. Store publication, production services and new paid dependencies require their own concrete action scope.

tasks.title: Run core regression, migration and design matrix
acceptance: Verify fresh install and baseline upgrade with full synthetic records and a restorable backup.
Cover all four tabs, sheets, both digit styles, nine brand accents, light/dark and 1.0/1.3 text scales; record motion separately.
verification: Run the focused shared/platform suites plus Android/iOS builds and inspect native screenshots/recordings.

tasks.title: Run physical-device accessibility, reliability and performance pass
acceptance: Check notification/background, camera, credentials, restore, file pickers and denied permissions on physical devices.
Measure startup, scroll, large-vault operations, memory and battery on a representative lower-resource Android plus an iPhone; define budgets from measurements.
verification: Use TalkBack/VoiceOver, large text, keyboard/focus and offline/failure scenarios; report measured budgets and results.

notes.text: P00-D07: iOS capture found unnamed clickable labels and inconsistent or zero hit frames during scrolling. Verify steady native accessibility and real-device control interaction.

evidence.summary: P00-D07: iOS capture found unnamed clickable labels and inconsistent or zero hit frames during scrolling. Verify steady native accessibility and real-device control interaction.

tasks.title: Pilot with representative Bangladesh owners and resolve release blockers
acceptance: Include commuters, a first-time/used-bike owner and an enthusiast; obtain consent for anonymized observations.
Track backup/restore success, reminder usefulness, log effort and cost comprehension; close data-loss/privacy/incorrect-guidance defects.
verification: Retain anonymized findings and explicit pass/fail release decisions; do not invent retention statistics before observing them.

tasks.title: Prepare and verify core release candidate and recovery handoff
acceptance: Record release build, signing/distribution state, enabled features, privacy/store declarations and known limits.
Prepare release notes, support/recovery instructions and rollout/rollback criteria; record actual distribution proof when performed.
verification: Install the signed candidate on both platforms and repeat the restore/upgrade smoke path; publication remains a separately authorized action.

phases.title: Multiple bikes and ownership boundaries
phases.outcome: Owners can keep separate bikes and histories without replacing an old bike record.
phases.rationale: Provides the ownership foundation for workshop records, resale and rider reports.
phases.design: Use the existing Home bike header to open a bike-selector sheet. Me manages add/archive; keep all four tabs and brand-logo picking with the selected bike theme.
phases.data: Migrate primary into a stable bike ID. Scope schedules/logs/assets/reminders/expenses by bike and licences by owner; preserve old single-bike backups and active-bike preference.
exit_criteria: Switching bikes cannot mix costs, schedules, files, reminders or Undo.
Archive preserves records; deleting a bike is a separately reviewed destructive action.
Old backups restore to one bike and new backups preserve every bike.
phases.risks: This is a significant migration. Freeze the ownership model before implementation and test inactive-bike notification routing.

tasks.title: Finalize garage ownership model and migration fixtures
acceptance: Define person versus bike documents, active/archive status, stable IDs and record ownership.
Map every existing primary record and shared asset to an explicit owner without duplication.
verification: Review migration cases with two bikes, shared owner documents, duplicate model names and archived bikes.

tasks.title: Implement bike-scoped persistence and backward-compatible backups
acceptance: Migrate existing data transactionally and retain all historical records and asset bytes.
Update backup versions, import/restore and cost/reminder queries to require correct bike scope.
verification: Test interrupted migration, old archive restore, no cross-bike queries and foreign-key/asset invariants.

tasks.title: Build bike switcher, add and archive in v3
acceptance: Open a recognizable bike-selector sheet from the Home header; preserve selection across restarts.
Adding does not replace history; archiving has a clear reversible state and inactive-bike visibility.
verification: Check per-bike brand accents/logos, focus, large text and no misleading empty state while switching.

tasks.title: Scope capture, notifications, privacy and Undo to a bike
acceptance: Deep links and share drafts identify the intended bike even if another is active.
A delayed save, notification or Undo cannot mutate the newly selected bike.
verification: Race bike switching against async capture/save/notification; check locked and archived targets.

tasks.title: Verify cross-bike isolation, migration and restore
acceptance: Run two-bike fresh/upgrade/backup scenarios on both hosts.
Totals, service tasks, renewals, files and app theme remain isolated with no loss of the original single-bike history.
verification: Retain fixture hashes, native flows and regression reports.

phases.title: Workshop, repair and parts warranty records
phases.outcome: Owners can explain previous repairs, compare quotations and follow up on a parts warranty.
phases.rationale: Builds on itemized service visits without needing a public workshop marketplace.
phases.design: ServiceSheet adds a recent-workshop picker and optional repair/warranty details. History expands into a repair detail sheet, using existing rows, chips and attachments.
phases.data: Add owner-managed contacts, quotations, repair cases and warranty dates linked to bike/service/part IDs. Distinguish quoted cost from actual paid expense.
exit_criteria: Quotation, actual service, recurring issue and warranty coverage remain distinguishable.
Contacts are entered/selected deliberately with no address-book upload.
Related photos/receipts follow privacy and backup policies.
phases.risks: Owner history is not a verified public workshop rating. Avoid duplicate expenses from a quotation and a later service.

tasks.title: Model workshops, repair cases, quotations and warranty links
acceptance: Link recurring issues and parts warranties to actual visits; keep contacts owner-managed.
Separate quotation, approved work and paid expense states.
verification: Test repeated repairs, expired warranty, duplicate workshop names and migrated free-text workshop fields.

tasks.title: Implement contact and repair/warranty flows in v3
acceptance: Extend the current service sheet with optional detail sections and a recent-workshop chooser.
Show repair timeline, receipt and warranty reminder actions in History.
verification: Exercise quote-to-service, edits, cancelled work, contact call action and no attachment leak when locked.

tasks.title: Connect expenses, warranty reminders and portable records
acceptance: Only actual paid work contributes to costs; service/reminder links survive edits and Undo.
Backup/restore includes contacts, cases, warranties and referenced assets.
verification: Check no duplicate expense/reminder and cross-bike isolation after restore.

tasks.title: Verify workshop and recurring-repair scenarios
acceptance: Run a quote, completed repair, repeat issue and warranty follow-up on Android and iOS.
Preserve v3 quick service entry when no optional repair detail is needed.
verification: Retain native and calculation/backup evidence.

phases.title: Used-bike handover pack and service passport
phases.outcome: A seller can share a selected, understandable ownership history while retaining control of private data.
phases.rationale: Extends the existing passport into a useful used-bike handover workflow.
phases.design: History > Service passport opens a selection/review sheet; Me/bike settings links to an ownership-transfer checklist. Match existing export review and native share behavior.
phases.data: Version the export separately from backup. Export selected records with provenance, history gaps, generated date and optional redaction; do not transfer the seller account, local keys or private documents by default.
exit_criteria: Owner previews exactly what is shared and can exclude contacts, IDs, locations, receipts and documents.
Clearly distinguish owner-entered, imported and supported workshop evidence.
A digest proves consistency of covered data, not mechanic authenticity, legal ownership or physical bike condition.
phases.risks: Official transfer requirements change. A handover pack does not execute legal ownership transfer or erase the seller vault.

tasks.title: Define selective pack, provenance and privacy defaults
acceptance: Specify export schema, selected bike scope, unknown-history disclosures and per-field redaction.
Define what the digest covers and keep official ownership transfer a separate checklist.
verification: Review misleading authenticity claims and inspect the exact default field selection.

tasks.title: Extend passport export and verification without breaking old versions
acceptance: Generate reviewed PDF/data with stable canonical encoding and clear provenance.
Verify supported old passports and detect tampering; do not label a recomputed self-digest as third-party authentication.
verification: Use independent golden digests, version fixtures, unknown fields, altered PDF/data and redaction-leak checks.

tasks.title: Build handover selection, preview and sourced checklist
acceptance: Reuse v3 sheets and native sharing with explicit selected-bike and recipient-visible preview.
Show source freshness and working official links; share/cancel never changes ownership records.
verification: Check long histories, page layout, large text, offline checklist and export cleanup on both platforms.

tasks.title: Verify buyer-readable output and privacy boundaries
acceptance: Render/inspect every PDF page and verify the paired data independently.
Record both native share/cancel paths and no leakage of excluded fields or other bikes.
verification: Use a synthetic seller/buyer scenario; confirm original records remain unchanged.

phases.title: Real home-screen widgets and fast actions
phases.outcome: Owners can see the next task and open fuel/odometer entry without navigating through the app.
phases.rationale: Makes the prototype widget concept useful on the actual phone.
phases.design: Promote Me widget preview to native setup/help. Widget uses the v3 visual roles with minimal summary and direct links to existing quick-add sheets.
phases.data: Publish a minimal, non-sensitive durable snapshot for the chosen bike. Never expose document IDs or decrypted vault data; stale snapshot time is explicit.
exit_criteria: Real Android and iOS widgets render the selected bike and navigate to correct locked/unlocked entry points.
Widget refresh follows OS constraints and indicates stale data.
Disabling/removing a widget leaves owner data unchanged.
phases.risks: An in-app preview is not a native widget. iOS needs extension/app-group/entitlement review and minimal data sharing; no precise refresh-time promise.

tasks.title: Define minimal widget snapshot and deep-link contract
acceptance: Specify bike scope, last-update time, permitted summary fields and privacy behavior.
Use read-only snapshots and route mutations to reviewed app sheets.
verification: Test archived/missing bike, locked state and stale snapshot selection.

tasks.title: Implement Android widget and iOS widget extension
acceptance: Implement actual host widgets with reviewed entitlements and minimal shared storage.
Update after durable relevant changes and handle OS refresh limits.
verification: Install/add/remove widgets and test process death, reboot, locked device and stale data on physical devices.

tasks.title: Connect widget setup and quick actions to v3
acceptance: Replace preview-only wording with truthful setup, availability and selected-bike controls.
Fuel and odometer actions open the corresponding sheet after any required unlock.
verification: Inspect widget typography, contrast, theme variants and native deep-link focus.

tasks.title: Verify widget lifecycle, privacy and resource use
acceptance: Document measured refresh behavior and snapshot freshness under real OS constraints.
Confirm no private fields leak and no aggressive background polling is introduced.
verification: Retain physical Android/iPhone screenshots and lifecycle/battery observations.

phases.title: Seasonal care and user-controlled breakdown help
phases.outcome: Owners can find relevant care checks and their chosen help contacts when needed.
phases.rationale: Adds practical wet-weather and breakdown support without requiring constant tracking.
phases.design: Home shows at most one dismissible care card when relevant. A Help sheet holds saved contacts, manual location and deliberate share; keep the urgent maintenance card first.
phases.data: Store selected region, content source/version and owner-chosen contacts. Use optional foreground location only; freshness/expiry are part of any cached weather item.
exit_criteria: Offline care checklists are available with source and applicability.
Weather alerts have official attribution and freshness; a public API is not assumed.
Calling/sharing requires owner action and no automatic SOS or continuous location collection.
phases.risks: A weather warning does not establish road safety. Start with sourced links/manual region; add a live feed only after terms, availability and data handling are verified.

tasks.title: Review seasonal content, sources and help boundaries
acceptance: Source wet/dust/heat care instructions from applicable manuals and weather links from BMD.
Define offline-only behavior first; select contacts manually and avoid unsupported emergency promises.
verification: Review source freshness, applicability and stale/unavailable weather wording.

tasks.title: Implement offline care checklist and bounded optional weather access
acceptance: Show region, last update and expired-cache state; no precise background location is needed.
Follow source terms and use an external official link if no supported feed is available.
verification: Test offline, stale cache, unavailable source and dismissing/re-enabling a card.

tasks.title: Build breakdown contacts and deliberate location sharing in v3
acceptance: Keep contacts available offline; open native call/share actions deliberately.
Show location accuracy/time and editable text; denial or no GPS still allows help.
verification: Test no network, no location, timeout, locked app and share cancellation on both physical devices.

tasks.title: Verify care relevance, offline help and privacy
acceptance: Check region/bike scope and that care cards do not displace the most urgent task.
Record source review and physical-device contact/location behavior with synthetic contacts.
verification: Verify no background tracking or automatic communication and inspect accessibility states.

phases.title: Optional professional-rider earnings mode
phases.outcome: A rider can understand recorded work earnings after operating costs.
phases.rationale: Useful to delivery/ride-sharing riders while keeping ordinary ownership logging simple.
phases.design: Me enables Work mode; History gains an optional work filter/summary and a quick-entry sheet. Default Home and four-tab navigation remain intact.
phases.data: Add work shifts, earnings, deductions, work-distance attribution and owner-defined maintenance allowance. Keep actual expenses separate from estimates and prevent double subtraction.
exit_criteria: Mode is opt-in and hidden from everyday flows when disabled.
Net figures reconcile with selected recorded income, deductions and allocated costs.
No earnings guarantee, automated platform account access or background tracking is implied.
phases.risks: Business/personal expense attribution needs explicit rules and usable corrections. Validate the module with actual professional riders before enabling broadly.

tasks.title: Validate rider workflow and define accounting boundaries
acceptance: Observe representative riders and define shift, work kilometres, earnings, deductions and cost-allocation rules.
Separate maintenance allowance from actual expense and show incomplete records clearly.
verification: Review worked examples with mixed personal/work use, delayed payout and refunds.

tasks.title: Implement opt-in work ledger and reconciled summaries
acceptance: Store money in poisha, scope to bike/shift and support corrections.
Do not double-count fuel/service expenses or treat a budget allowance as cash paid.
verification: Test mixed use, payout deductions, no mileage, backdated corrections and backup/restore.

tasks.title: Build optional work entry and reports in v3
acceptance: Reuse keypad, date chips, quick-add and History summaries.
Disabling Work mode preserves records and removes routine entry clutter.
verification: Run no-work, mixed-work and incomplete-shift flows with both digit styles and large text.

tasks.title: Pilot rider mode and decide enablement
acceptance: Reconcile sample summaries independently and collect anonymized rider feedback.
Record whether the optional module is ready to enable; core release remains independent.
verification: Run Android/iOS scenarios plus an agreed representative-rider pilot.

phases.title: Optional encrypted cloud backup and device recovery
phases.outcome: An owner can recover a portable encrypted snapshot from an explicitly connected account.
phases.rationale: Build cloud transport only after local encrypted restore and bike-scoped ownership are proven.
phases.design: Me > Backup adds explicit connect/disconnect, last successful backup, pending/error state and restore selection using the same local restore review.
phases.data: Reuse the portable encrypted manifest with immutable objects, account-to-vault binding, authenticated publication and remote revision preconditions. Device restore creates a reviewed local state; do not silently multi-writer merge ciphertext.
exit_criteria: Only ciphertext and minimal approved metadata reach the chosen provider.
Two-account isolation, conflict handling, cancelled uploads, retry and cross-device recovery pass in staging.
Account switching cannot assign existing local records to a new owner; recovery secrets and remote retention/deletion are explicit.
phases.risks: Supabase is an existing preparation seam, not a deployed backend. Provider, project, auth, cost/quota, recovery and production actions need concrete decisions. Concurrent multi-device editing is separate future scope.

tasks.title: Select provider/account model and review cloud recovery design
acceptance: Record provider choice, project, auth, billing/quota, key recovery and metadata disclosure.
Define explicit account binding, logout/switch behavior, retention, remote deletion and single-writer/conflict behavior.
verification: Review against existing local-sync contract and complete the chosen provider security/terms review before deployment.

tasks.title: Implement staged backend isolation and publication contract
acceptance: Use private immutable encrypted objects, owner-scoped authorization and atomic revision-checked publication.
Keep privileged service credentials out of app builds; make receipt/idempotency checks enforceable server-side.
verification: Run account A/B denial tests, cross-owner object paths, duplicate operation IDs and concurrent revision conflicts in the selected staging project.

tasks.title: Implement encrypted uploader, retries and account lifecycle
acceptance: Freeze a durable revision, encrypt and upload all referenced assets before publishing its manifest.
Stop jobs on logout/switch and retain newer queued revisions when acknowledging an older upload.
verification: Test network loss, token expiry, cancellation, process death, stale revisions, quota and account switch.

tasks.title: Build truthful connection, backup status and restore selection
acceptance: Show disconnected/pending/running/failed/last-success states based on confirmed transport results.
Use existing restore preview and explicit account/vault/secret review; no connected badge from configuration alone.
verification: Exercise offline/error/auth/conflict and accessible progress without blocking local record entry.

tasks.title: Run cross-device recovery, isolation and failure drills
acceptance: Restore Android-to-iPhone and iPhone-to-Android with a new device and correct recovery method.
Prove wrong-account denial, missing-asset rejection, altered ciphertext rejection and no overwrite on conflict.
verification: Retain sanitized staging reports, manifests/hashes and physical-device recovery evidence.

tasks.title: Review production readiness and explicitly enable cloud backup
acceptance: Record actual production configuration, provider cost controls, retention/recovery support and reviewed release settings.
Enable only after concrete production-action authorization and recorded smoke proof; otherwise keep cloud disconnected.
verification: Verify signed app account binding, actual backup receipt and restore path in the approved environment.

phases.title: Expanded ownership release and ongoing maintenance
phases.outcome: The additional ownership features ship with regression evidence and a maintained support/source-refresh process.
phases.rationale: Protects the reliable core while adding more models, records and OS integrations.
phases.design: Run the complete v3 matrix for the core and enabled additions, including multi-bike accents and native widget surfaces. Optional modules remain disabled until their own gates pass.
phases.data: Document the complete supported upgrade/backup matrix, retention policy and model/manual content versions; old records and passport formats remain readable as promised.
exit_criteria: Core and additional ownership workflows pass a full old-install upgrade and physical-device regression.
Every enabled optional module has passed P14-04/P15-06 as applicable.
Support instructions, source freshness ownership and measured release/pilot outcomes are assigned.
phases.risks: Do not mark an optional service enabled merely to make the roadmap percentage increase. Treat a deferred feature as visible unshipped scope.

tasks.title: Run expanded migration, backup and v3 regression matrix
acceptance: Upgrade from baseline and core release with multiple bikes, repair records, handover exports and all asset types.
Recheck design, accessibility, widgets, reminders and privacy on both physical platforms.
verification: Run shared/platform suites and retain independent cost totals, archive hashes and native recordings.

tasks.title: Verify enabled-module gates and expanded release candidate
acceptance: Keep P14/P15 disabled unless their completion gates pass; record exactly what is enabled.
Prepare signed candidate, upgrade/recovery notes, support handoff and rollout decision.
verification: Install candidate on both platforms, run fresh/upgrade/restore smoke and record distribution state separately.

tasks.title: Assign maintenance ownership and review observed product outcomes
acceptance: Assign manual/checklist/link freshness, OS compatibility, backup drills and privacy support ownership.
Review observed log completion, restore success, reminder action and comprehension; create next work from evidence.
verification: Retain an anonymized release/pilot review with a dated next review and explicit action owners; do not create a scheduled automation without a separate request.
